= nested-link-punctuation(1)
:doctype: manpage
:manmanual: Link punctuation
:mansource: acdc
:revdate: 2026-10-02

== NAME

nested-link-punctuation - preserve split label boundaries

== DESCRIPTION

N01 link:https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner] after].

N02 link:https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner],after].

N03 link:https://outer.example[Before *bold mailto:test@example.org[Inner] end* after].

N04 link:https://outer.example[mailto:test@example.org[Inner] after].

N05 link:https://outer.example[mailto:test@example.org[Inner]].

N06 link:https://outer.example[mailto:first@example.org[First] mailto:second@example.org[Second]].

N07 link:https://outer.example[mailto:first@example.org[First]mailto:second@example.org[Second]].

N08 *link:https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner] after].*

N09 link:https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner]  after].

N10 link:https://outer.example[Before footnote:n[Note with https://note.example[Note].] mailto:test@example.org[Inner] after].

N11 link:https://outer.example[Before *bold ((Term mailto:test@example.org[Inner]))* (((Hidden))) after].

N12 link:https://outer.example[Before image:picture.svg[Picture,link=https://image.example] after].

N13 link:https://outer.example[Début mailto:test@example.org[Été] fin].

N14 link:https://outer.example[Before mailto:test@example.org[Inner]
after].
